title: Red Hat Security Advisory: java-25-openjdk security update for RHEL 9
description: Red Hat has released a critical security update for the java-25-openjdk packages in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9. This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities in the OpenJDK 25 Java Runtime Environment and Software Development Kit, including enhancements and fixes related to Kerberos tickets, TLS connections, StringBuilder checks, JFR events, loop handling, vector masks, integer compression, JMX connections, and Base64 optimization. Additionally, a bug fix disables post-quantum hybrid key exchange in TLS 1.3 when running in FIPS mode to prevent negotiation failures.
